tasks.title: Question 31
tasks.promptText: Theo wants to talk about camping weekend. what tent to bring. what food to pack. when to leave.

promptBlocks.text: Read this email from your English friend Theo.

promptBlocks.subject: Camping weekend
paragraphs: I am writing about camping weekend. what tent to bring? what food to pack?
when to leave? Please write soon.

promptBlocks.text: Write an email to Theo and answer the questions.

tasks.title: Question 32
tasks.promptText: Look at the three pictures. Write the story shown in the pictures.

ketImageBrief.title: camping weekend
ketImageBrief.panel1: Theo starts camping weekend with a clear plan.
ketImageBrief.panel2: A small problem changes the plan.
ketImageBrief.panel3: Theo solves it and finishes happily.
continuityNotes: Keep the same child and objects in all three panels.
